name: auxtools-debugger
description: Debug BYOND (DreamMaker) worlds with auxtools: breakpoints, stepping, variables and expressions, with nothing to add to your code

auxtools.byondPath.markdownDescription: Where BYOND is installed (the directory with `bin` in it). Empty to look in the usual places: `BYOND_SYSTEM`, the registry, `Program Files`, `~/byond`.

auxtools.launcherPath.markdownDescription: A launcher (`auxtools`) to use instead of the one that comes with the extension.

auxtools.debugLibrary.markdownDescription: A debug library (`debug_server.dll` or `libdebug_server.so`) to load instead of the one next to the launcher.

dme.description: The world's .dme, if it isn't the one next to the .dmb. Its directory is where the world's files are, and hot reloading reads it.

enumDescriptions: DreamSeeker, which hosts the world and joins it (Windows)
DreamDaemon without a window (dd.exe on Windows), whose output shows in the debug console
server.description: The BYOND program that runs the world. DreamSeeker on Windows, DreamDaemon on Linux, unless set.

defines.description: The -D defines the .dmb was built with, NAME or NAME=VALUE: hot reloading reads the code as DreamMaker did

hotReload.description: Swap changed code into the running world as files are saved, with or without debugging

noDebug.description: Run the world without debugging: no breakpoints or pauses, and hot reloading still works. The same as starting it with Run Without Debugging.

sleepingThreads.description: How many sleeping procs the call stack view lists when the world is paused, after the proc that was running

byondPath.description: Where BYOND is installed, if not the auxtools.byondPath setting or the usual places

args.description: What follows the .dmb on the program's command line, in place of the defaults (-trusted, and -close for DreamDaemon on Windows)

debugLibrary.description: The debug library to load, if not the one that comes with the extension

processId.description: The process running the world. Unset, you pick from the worlds running auxtools' debugger.

dme.description: The world's .dme, if it isn't next to the .dmb the world runs

defines.description: DreamMaker's -D defines the world was built with, for reading the code

hotReload.description: Swap changed code into the world as files are saved. Off unless set: whoever launched the world may be reloading it already.

sleepingThreads.description: How many sleeping procs the call stack view lists when the world is paused, after the proc that was running
